newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee ends at 35.71/72 per dlr in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: India rupee ends at 35.71/72 per dlr in dull trade.

text.p: *The Indian rupee closed at 35.71/72 per dollar on Wednesday, compared to the opening quote of 35.72/74, dealers said.
*The dollar traded in a narrow range. It saw a high of 35.73 and a low of 35.71 rupees on Wednesday, dealers said.
*Dealers said the Reserve Bank of India continued to buy dollars on Wednesday at 35.72-35.73 levels.
*The forward premia fell on market expectations of a relaxation in cash reserve ratio for banks, dealers said.
